## What to Expect

Arrive in San José on the first day and rest after your journey. Early the next morning, travel through Braulio Carrillo National Park towards Tortuguero, passing banana plantations before boarding a covered boat for the canals.

In Tortuguero, the itinerary centres on the waterways and wildlife. Cruise the canals to your lodge, visit the village and the Caribbean coast, and take an early-morning wildlife boat tour the following day.

After your time on the Caribbean coast, return to the Central Valley. Visit the Doka coffee plantation to discover the stages of Costa Rican coffee production, then explore the trails and lush gardens of La Paz Waterfall Gardens.
